maya: Woke to three kv_cache flap pages overnight. Short spikes ~40s but still paging. Need a quick tune + owner.
jon: is this the rule that looks at region-wide miss rate?
maya: yep, model_serving.kv_cache.flap. Autoscaler churn seems correlated.
eli: short-term: change paging to warn for blips <4m, keep page for >=4m. Add suppression 12m keyed by alert fingerprint.
jon: +1. I'll open a tiny PR to adjust 'for' and suppression. Will validate in staging.
oncall-bot: Staging deploy: prometheus rules updated by jon at 1768509900.
maya: assigning follow-ups: eli -> remediation ticket & runbook note; jon -> dedupe key + PR; maya -> monitor pager noise after deploy. ETA: runbook tomorrow EOD, dedupe PR Tue.
eli: created ticket RMD-3499 and added the incident links and graphs.
jon: PR: https://git.internal/repo/prom-alerts/pull/489. Includes unit tests.
maya: thanks. Sync Friday to review 24h firing counts.
eli: will draft a one-paragraph triage note for oncall playbook about "flap vs sustained".
jon: monitoring overnight, will report any regressions here.
maya: thanks team. :thumbsup:
